answer_1.quote: Comprehending and executing procedures articulated in natural language to achieve a specified goal represents a fundamental challenge for Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems.
datasets: 16,194 experimental protocols across five domains: Genetics, Medical and Clinical Research, Ecology and Environmental Research, Bioengineering, and Computational Biology
answer_1.outputs: DSL-based constraints for procedural representation in experimental sciences

answer_2.quote: We check the mapping from ontology elements in the reference model, i.e., concepts and relations in the domain corpus, to DSL constructs of constraints, focusing on four criteria: soundness, lucidity, completeness, and laconicity.

answer_3.quote: We institute an automatic evaluation framework leveraging a state-of-the-art LLM, e.g., GPT-4, augmented with a novel Question-answering System (QA System) designed to simulate the analytical capabilities of human domain experts.

answer_4.quote: The meta-evaluation and data annotation included in this work has been approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) of Peking University. We have been committed to upholding the highest ethical standards in conducting this study and ensuring the protection of the rights and welfare of all participants.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each item on a scale where 1 indicates 'Strongly Disagree' and 5 indicates 'Strongly Agree'. Indicate your level of confidence in your response to each item, where 1 is 'Not Confident at All' and 5 is 'Extremely Confident'.
